heading: Thursday, June 26, 2025
topLine: 2 model releases: Google Gemma 3n and Alibaba Qwen VLo.

items.headline: Google fully releases Gemma 3n on-device open models
items.summary: Gemma 3n is a mobile-first open model family in E2B and E4B sizes that accepts image, audio, video and text input. Google says the models can run in as little as 2GB and 3GB of memory; weights are on Hugging Face and Kaggle.

items.headline: Alibaba previews Qwen VLo image understanding and generation model
items.summary: Qwen VLo is a unified multimodal understanding and generation model that creates and edits images from text instructions, including bilingual text rendering. It launched as a preview in Qwen Chat.
